jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Associate Software Developer
jobs.description:
:

**Associate Software Developer - Hybrid, Glasgow, UK**

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

**About the job**

The Research and Development Risk team is looking for an Associate Software Developer. We build and support a cloud-native platform for SAS's financial-risk solutions, used by banks and insurers around the world. The platform runs on Kubernetes and is built from backend services, a SAS programming layer, a web UI, and tooling for deployment and testing.

We're a collaborative team that works on new features and customer support, and ships updates regularly. We value careful investigation, clear communication and sharing knowledge.

**As an Associate Software Developer, you will:**

* Fix defects and make small improvements across the platform.
* Write and maintain code and unit tests, following the team's existing patterns.
* Add and maintain automated tests to keep the product reliable.
* Help investigate reported issues and learn to find their root cause.
* Track your work in Jira. Keep tickets up to date with progress, findings and fix details, and link each ticket to its pull request.
* Open pull requests and take part in code reviews (yours and others').
* Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily work and learn to check their output.
* Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
* Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

**Required qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree, or one in progress, in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Internships, coursework and personal projects count.
* Programming experience in at least one language, such as Python, Go, Java or C#.
* Basic SQL, such as writing SELECT queries with joins and filters.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and HTTP.
* Basic familiarity with Git and the command line.
* Curiosity and patience when debugging, and willingness to ask questions.
* Clear written English.
* Proof of Right to work in the UK
* Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.

**Additional competencies, knowledge and skills**

* Collaboration - Working cooperatively with others to help a team or work group achieve its goals.
* Technology Savvy - Leveraging one’s practical knowledge and understanding of recent technology tools, solutions, and trends to improve work results, solve work problems, and take advantage of new business opportunities.
* Communication - Conveying information and ideas clearly and concisely to individuals or groups in an engaging manner that helps them understand and retain the message; listening actively to others.
* Any exposure to SAS programming, for example from a university course or SAS certification.
* Some experience with Docker, Kubernetes or a cloud platform.
* Some experience with JavaScript or React.
* Interest in finance, banking or risk management.

**You are welcome here.**

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

**Additional Information:**

*SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact* *Recruitingsupport@sas.com.*

Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.

#SAS

jobs.title: Senior Manager - AI for Engineering Systems
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

As an Account Executive on our UK Public Sector team, you will own the Defence territory: selling the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to the Ministry of Defence, defence primes, system integrators, and allied national security organisations. This is a mission-driven, field-based role for someone who understands how data transforms Defence outcomes and can navigate the sensitivities of secure and sovereign environments.

**As an Account Executive you will:**

* Prospect, win, and onboard net-new Defence logos across the UK, breaking into MOD commands, defence primes, and strategic SIs that are not yet Snowflake customers
* Run complex, consultative sales cycles that align the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to mission priorities such as readiness, logistics, intelligence, and command and control
* Position Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, and secure data sharing for sovereign, air-gapped, and high-assurance workloads
* Partner with Solution Engineers to design architectures that meet Defence security, residency, and accreditation requirements
* Navigate UK public sector procurement, including G-Cloud, Digital Outcomes, and framework and direct-award routes
* Build trusted relationships with mission owners, programme leads, and procurement, from technical practitioners to senior leadership
* Collaborate with partners, resellers, and cleared delivery teams to land and expand mission-critical data programmes
* Forecast accurately and manage pipeline through the full sales cycle, from qualification to close and expansion

**Our Ideal Account Executive Will Have:**

* 5+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, or data platform sales experience, with consistent quota overachievement
* A proven track record selling into UK Defence
* Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and long-horizon programme engagements
* Working knowledge of UK public sector procurement frameworks and the realities of secure or classified environments
* Fluency in articulating the value of data, analytics, and AI to mission outcomes
* Strong commercial discipline across territory planning, forecasting, and negotiation
* The ability to hold or obtain UK security clearance (SC or above) as required by the territory

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

* Experience selling cloud data platforms, data warehousing, or AI and machine learning solutions
* An existing network across MOD, defence primes, or allied agencies
* Familiarity with secure data sharing, data sovereignty, and high-assurance deployment patterns
* Experience working alongside system integrators and cleared delivery partners

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
As a recruitment company, DCG understands that every business is powered by experienced professionals. Our management style and partnership approach enable us to meet your needs and provide continuous support. Due to our ongoing growth and the large number of recruitment projects we undertake for our partners, we are currently looking for:

**Fullstack Engineer**
----------------------

**Responsibilities:**

* Designing and implementing scalable backend services and RESTful APIs within a domain-driven and event-driven architecture context, including both modular monolith and microservices approaches
* Building and maintaining responsive frontend interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with backend systems
* Contributing to architectural decisions and participating in collaborative design sessions to align technical solutions with business requirements
* Writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; ensuring code quality through thorough code reviews and adherence to team standards
* Working with CI/CD pipelines, containerised deployments, and infrastructure as code
* Implementing asynchronous communication patterns and event-based integrations between services
* Configuring and utilising monitoring and observability tools for application diagnostics and performance analysis
* Collaborating within an agile team, working closely with business analysts to refine requirements, and actively participating in sprint ceremonies

  

**Requirements:**

* At least 4 years of experience on a similar position
* Very good knowledge of ASP.NET WebAPI (.NET Core)
* Very good knowledge of React, TypeScript
* Very good knowledge of SQL Server/Azure SQL, EF Core
* Very good knowledge or experience in Unit Testing and GIT
* Good command of English

  

**Offer:**

* Constant support of dedicated consultant
* Employee referral program

jobs.title: Mjukvaruutvecklare Desktop och diagnostikverktyg (C# / .NET)
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning På Bosch Thermoteknik AB i Tranås formar vi framtiden för hållbart boende. Som en nyckelaktör inom divisionen Bosch Home Comfort utvecklar och tillverkar vi värme- och kyllösningar i världsklass. Vi tillhör affärsenheten Electric Solutions (ES), som leder den globala energiomställningen genom utveckling av modern och innovativ värmepumpsteknik. För att våra högeffektiva system ska fungera optimalt förlitar sig vårt nätverk med över 1 000 servicetekniker runtom i Europa – liksom våra utvecklingslaboratorier – på pålitliga och moderna desktopapplikationer och mjukvaruverktyg.
  
  
Vi söker nu en engagerad Mjukvaruutvecklare till vårt team i Tranås. I den här rollen tar du ägarskap över centrala applikationer som vårt fältverktyg SWDL (Software Download) samt utvecklar skräddarsydda verktyg för loggning, datainsamling och diagnostik som underlättar vardagen för våra testingenjörer i labbet vid verifiering av värmepumpar. Om rollen Utveckling av desktopapplikationer: Designa, bygga och underhålla moderna Windowsapplikationer med C# och .NET-ekosystemet (.NET Framework / moderna .NET). Stötta labbingenjörer: Utveckla intuitiva verktyg för dataloggning, monitorering och diagnostik som används av testingenjörer för att fånga och analysera systembeteenden i realtid vid labbtester.
  
  
**Flashing och mjukvaruuppdateringar:** Förvalta och förbättra stabila rutiner för mjukvarunedladdning och flashning av firmware, både för labbmiljöer och för serviceverksamhet i fält. Kommunikation med hårdvara och enheter: Implementera och stödja robusta kommunikationsgränssnitt mellan desktopmjukvaran och inbyggda styrsystem eller testutrustning (till exempel seriell kommunikation och CAN-bus). Tvärfunktionellt samarbete: Arbeta nära utvecklare inom inbyggda system (firmware), hårdvaruspecialister och testingenjörer för att stämma av krav och verifiera nya versioner av verktygen. Användbarhet och ständiga förbättringar: Förbättra UI/UX, automatisera datavisualisering och effektivisera arbetsflöden så att komplexa diagnostik- och testprocesser blir enkla och driftsäkra.
  
  
**Kravspecifikation Utbildning:** Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, elektroteknik, mjukvaruteknik eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet. God kompetens inom C#: Gedigen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling för desktop med C# och .NET. Förståelse för hårdvarukommunikation och diagnostik: Erfarenhet av mjukvara som kommunicerar med hårdvara, enhetskommunikation (t.ex. CAN-bus) samt diagnostik- eller flashrutiner (som UDS och bootloaders).
  
  
**Kunskaper i Python (meriterande):** Erfarenhet av Python är ett stort plus för skriptning, testautomatisering, dataanalys och snabb framtagning av prototyper. Förståelse för inbyggda system (meriterande): Kunskaper i C eller C++ är meriterande och underlättar dialogen och samarbetet med utvecklarna som programmerar mikrokontrollerna. Erfarenhet av labbmiljö och mätverktyg: Praktisk bakgrund inom testverktyg, dataloggers, telemetri eller testautomatisering är starkt meriterande. Analytisk problemlösare: Ett strukturerat och metodiskt arbetssätt vid felsökning av mjukvarans interaktion med hårdvara och analys av kommunikationsloggar.
  
  
**Språkkunskaper:** Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift är ett krav. Kunskaper i svenska är starkt meriterande för det dagliga samarbetet på plats i Tranås. Ytterligare information Vad vi erbjuder dig Betydelsefull påverkan: Direkt ägarskap över verktyg som är affärskritiska både för den dagliga forskningen och utvecklingen i våra labb och för servicetekniker runtom i Europa. Flexibilitet: Moderna möjligheter till hybridarbete och flexibla arbetstider som främjar en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid.
  
  
**Hållbar teknik:** Möjligheten att vara en del av en organisation dedikerad till grön spetsteknik (elektrifiering, naturliga köldmedier såsom propan, och intelligent klimatstyrning). Utveckling och kultur: Breda utvecklingsmöjligheter för både personlig och professionell tillväxt inom den globala Bosch-koncernen.
